cp.title: SVELTE HUB TECH LABS
cp.heroDesc: Modern micro-apps development hub built with Svelte 5, Vite, and the Neo Brutalism design system. We engineer digital solutions that are fast, robust, and a joy to use.
cp.visionDesc: To become the premier centralized platform for internal micro applications, delivering a seamless navigation experience, distinctive visual aesthetic, and uncompromising workflow efficiency.
cp.mission1: Boosting team productivity through an integrated micro-app dashboard.
cp.mission2: Enforcing cutting-edge code standards using Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS, & Playwright.
cp.mission3: Providing direct communication channels (WhatsApp PIC) for every application line.
cp.service1Desc: Centralizing diverse internal tools, workplace portals, and trackers under one unified dashboard.
cp.service2Desc: Bold and expressive high-contrast design, solid borders, and tactile interactive elements.
cp.service3Desc: End-to-end automated verification and continuous QA powered by Playwright.
cp.leadRole: Lead Systems Architect & Core Developer — Svelte Hub Labs
cp.leadBio: Responsible for high-performance architecture, robust micro-app integrations, and Neo Brutalism design system standardization.
